This dog looks like she just heard the most shocking news of her life! Meet Belle, the sweet rescue dog with a permanent look of surprise. Her family adopted her from the Humane Society as a puppy. According to her owner, Belle likely got stuck during birth, affecting how her facial muscles developed and giving her that unforgettable expression. But her rise to internet fame happened completely by accident. Her owner posted a mirror for sale online, and Belle appeared in the reflection! People quickly forgot about the mirror. They wanted to know about the wide-eyed dog staring back at herself. That little photo turned Belle into a viral sensation. Behind that surprised face is a beloved family dog who became famous simply by being herself.
